title: Business English Conversation 22:  Back in the Black
content: 1. to make a profit: to make money from a business - Our company has made a profit every year for the last 20 years. - Did we make a profit last quarter? 2. to get a raise: to get an increase in one's salary or wage - I hope that I get a raise this year. - Did you get a raise when you got promoted? 3. to do well financially: to make or earn a lot of money - Mark and Tina are doing well financially. - Our company is doing well financially.
